critique: The fresco-grained Renaissance arcade, jewel-toned flowers, darting hummingbirds, and tiny shadow-hidden guinea pig create a richly staged garden with genuine charm and playful discovery. The strict bilateral urn-and-topiary symmetry and repeated petal ellipses feel overly decorous; introducing living circuitry, bioluminescent vines, or more disruptive bird trajectories would add the cyber-nature novelty and compositional surprise the scene currently lacks.
